Should homes be demolished to finish the Sagrada Família?
01 · THE PLOT
The Sagrada Família takes up an entire block of the Eixample.
01 · THE PLOT
Its main façade, the Glory, faces Carrer de Mallorca.
1916: Gaudí imagined a star-shaped square to see the temple from everywhere.
Because of land costs, he cut it to four points.
03 · THE GLORY
The Glory façade juts out 35 m, and its staircase leaps over the street to the block opposite.
1974: a licence for an 11-storey block right in front of the Glory.
1976: the General Plan reserves two blocks for a 60 m avenue.
Worst case: 1,020 homes.
05 · THE SCALE
Since then, many proposals. In 2024, options of 171 and 92 homes.
July 2026: a pre-agreement. 194 flats, rehousing next door and no avenue.
07 · TODAY
The City Council has yet to decide.
